scope: Declared-sRGB DICOM with arbitrary preambles beginning classic TIFF and BigTIFF in both byte orders, plus ICO and CUR magic. Every reported frame must preserve direct normalized selected-frame equality and metadata, with managed memory zero after each baseline/variant group.
limitations: One underlying DICOM fixture; does not establish all transfer syntax, photometric, window or clinical data semantics.
Selected-frame equality does not prove whole-file identity.
